beats.learns: Juno and a fern with a face are in a weekly standoff on a dark stage (the green bottle already on the shelf).
She guesses the dose with the watering can, and the fern answers back: still sulking.
The fern points at the Sprigly cap: one capful per litre.
One capful goes into the can, every two weeks in spring and summer.
The fern is a little perkier and the standoff is over.

book.rhythm: Original rhythm, about one cut every 2.5 s, with the pour as a 1.2 s insert; the payoff holds 2.5 s.
book.sound: A two-note sting on the standoff, a hollow tap when the leaf points, one bright glug for the pour.
